title: Synthetic-Categorical-Data
summary: A research notebook that generates synthetic categorical data to support causal modelling of accessibility barriers, comparing multiple synthesizers (including a custom DataSynthesizer library) against outputs from SDV. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer on tabular data and evaluates them with SDV's evaluate_quality and run_diagnostic functions.
